accessTitle: Recovery begins with a clear view.
accessText: Explore infrastructure, map dependencies and rehearse recovery in a safe synthetic workspace.
fakeLoginNote: This is a fake login for the sandbox. No identity provider is contacted and no real access is granted.
fakeMfaNote: Simulate the second factor to continue. Do not enter a real MFA code, password or recovery code.
sessionNote: Session only. Reloading ends the demo session and discards all synthetic changes.
subtitle: Your recovery landscape, in one place.
intro: Explore connected infrastructure and rehearse a recovery journey with synthetic data.
resetNote: Reset removes all simulated runs and added Harbors from this browser session.
name: Harbor
insightText: Missing signals stay unknown. Review freshness before making a recovery decision. This demo does not measure actual recovery readiness.
topologyText: An illustrative dependency map for the selected demo project. No cloud discovery has run.
recoveryText: Walk through a synthetic exercise. Nothing is provisioned, restored or deleted.
noRunsText: Start an exercise from Recovery to build a synthetic history.
historyText: Session-only synthetic history. Reloading discards it. No evidence is published or stored.
modeNote: Observation and operation need published core APIs, authoritative identity and independent permission. They cannot be enabled in this sandbox.
scopeNote: Demo filtering only. Real authorization belongs to the core API.
label: Display name
labelHint: 1–60 characters. Use an invented label; do not enter credentials or private identifiers.
invalidLabel: Enter a display name between 1 and 60 characters.
limit: This demo project allows up to 12 Harbors.
invalidTarget: Select a Harbor in this demo project.
alreadyRunning: Complete or cancel the current simulation first.
invalidRun: That simulation is unavailable in this project or has already ended.
startDone: Simulation started. No live action occurred.
inventoryText: Synthetic provider and resource projections. Provider names do not imply implemented adapters.
unknownNote: Unknown readings are deliberately left empty.
legend: Illustrative data · not a readiness certification
